notes: New default force management: place sectors, then assign brigades and companies to them. A sector grows as the force inside it grows, with diminishing returns
Automatic sectors push forward FOBs as close to the enemy as supply allows, put their guns in a rear FOB firing daily missions, rebase their own units and patrol every day
Morale sets conduct: worn-down units go heavy-handed, wrecking infrastructure, killing civilians and growing the insurgency faster; measured units shrink it
Prefer the old way? Settings › Force management › Classic
